title: 4 第四章
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

尘埃落定。

都竞华紧绷的心绪终于飘飘忽忽地落了地，长时间的射击让她的双臂几乎脱力，稍一抬起就会感觉酸痛。

水塔摇晃得越来越厉害，都竞华先慢慢爬了下来，随后按照记忆的位置开始回收箭矢，还有那些散乱于各处的烧烤长签。世界上存在科学无法解释的现象，但并不意味着科学的力量就从此失去效果，都竞华不想留下证据。

都竞华将烧烤长签收回背包中，原本是打算等路过垃圾处理区时找机会丢弃，不过背包空间贴心地提供销毁功能，大大提升了玩家互殴后的用户体验。

其实袭击者猜得不对，那些烧烤长签并非都是都竞华夜宵的产物，也有顺手从周边垃圾桶里回收的。

临时事件结束后，废弃小区的被封锁状态就随之消失，都竞华在水塔附近找到了袭击者的遗骸。

三具遗骸都处于相当奇怪的状态，他们身影随着时间的流逝逐渐变得淡薄，就像有某种力量正在将袭击者的存在慢慢从世界上擦除。

有种直面bug修复现场的感觉。

都竞华估算了一下，认为还有不到一分钟，袭击者的身体就会完全消失。

[事件预知]没再给都竞华带来任何不安感，此刻危机大概已经消失，都竞华却后知后觉地感受到了一种更加深刻，而且烙入骨髓的惊心动魄感。

原本正常的一天，莫名卷入了一个奇怪的游戏，又莫名遇到了种种危险……

都竞华回忆往事的时候，只觉太阳穴处传来阵阵刺痛，一些模糊的画面开始于眼前浮现。

大约是在一年前，周围毫无预兆地出现了许多游戏机，在都竞华的印象里，周围所有人都拥有一台。

可她完全想不起来游戏机是谁提供的，又是通过怎样的渠道落入大家的手中。

可与此同时，都竞华却清楚记得使用游戏机的种种要求。

游戏机中自带一些小游戏，刚开始很少，但玩的越多，能解锁的就越多，拥有游戏机的人需要定期游戏，不断探索，并记录其中的内容。

游戏与游戏之间也存在关联，所有游戏有一个共同的背景“失落大陆”。

都竞华记得自己就记录过许多副本的内容，可她完全不记得自己这样做的理由。

……总不能是闲的。

就像人要呼吸，鱼会游泳，人们毫无障碍地接受了被强加到身上的设定，玩游戏莫名其妙就变成了生活中的必选项。

有段时间，都竞华走到哪就将游戏机带到哪，一旦有空就拿出来折腾。

她本就不多的闲暇时间就这么被占据了大半，甚至还影响到了论文的完成进度。

然后不知从哪一天起，周围会坚持玩游戏机的人变得越来越少。

都竞华将游戏机放在了家中的杂物柜里，隔上好几天才会拿出来一次。

而她之所以会对最开始的迷宫巨人有印象，就是因为曾经在游戏机中玩到过相关游戏，只是那种印象已经变得非常浅淡，就像有某种力量在她的脑海中极具针对性地覆盖上了一层帷幔，让她想不起有关游戏机的一切。

将思绪从回忆中抽离出来，都竞华抓紧时间将袭击者的遗骸检查了一遍。

她将箭矢从袭击者的胸口拔出，用纸巾慢条斯理地擦拭着箭头。都竞华垂下目光凝视着地上的遗骸，表情里带了点与大学生气质不符的冷淡。

袭击者身边掉落了一些一看就充满非现实元素的物品。

【系统：恭喜玩家获得[背包空间]×2。备注：该物品已绑定。】

【系统：恭喜玩家获得[特质进化卡（指定）]×1。备注：该物品已绑定。】

【系统：恭喜玩家获得[N级技能卡]×1。】

就在都竞华捡完东西的那刻，袭击者的遗骸便彻底消失了。

她拢了下身上略显单薄的风衣，最后看了眼黑沉沉的废弃小区，头也不回地转身离开。

凌晨00:36分。

都竞华回到租住地的第一件事，就是去杂物柜里找那台游戏机，然后发现了一个好消息跟一个不明所以的消息。

好消息，游戏机确实还在。

不明所以的消息——游戏机被找出来之后，直接化成一道光，整个没入了都竞华的眉心。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

The dust has settled.

Du Jinghua's tense mind finally fell to the ground. The long shooting made her arms almost weak, and she would feel sore when she lifted them up.

The water tower shook more and more violently. Du Jinghua slowly climbed down first, and then began to recover the arrows according to the remembered positions, as well as the long barbecue sticks scattered everywhere.There are phenomena in the world that cannot be explained by science, but it does not mean that the power of science will lose its effectiveness. Du Jinghua does not want to leave any evidence.

Du Jinghua put the barbecue tag back into his backpack. He originally planned to throw it away when he passed by the garbage disposal area. However, the backpack space thoughtfully provided a destruction function, which greatly improved the user experience after players fight each other.

In fact, the attackers guessed wrong. Not all the barbecue tags were products of Du Jinghua Night Supper, but were also recycled from nearby trash cans.

After the temporary incident ended, the blockade of the abandoned community disappeared, and Du Jinghua found the remains of the attacker near the water tower.

The three remains are all in a rather strange state. Their figures gradually become fainter as time goes by, as if some kind of force is slowly erasing the existence of the attackers from the world.

It feels like facing the bug fixing site directly.

Du Jinghua estimated that in less than a minute, the attacker's body would completely disappear.

[Event Prediction] no longer brought any sense of uneasiness to Du Jinghua. The crisis had probably disappeared at this moment, but Du Jinghua felt a more profound and thrilling feeling that was deeply rooted in his bones.

It was a normal day, but I was inexplicably involved in a strange game, and encountered all kinds of dangers...

When Du Jinghua recalled the past, he felt a twinge of pain in his temples, and some blurry images began to appear in front of his eyes.

About a year ago, many game consoles appeared around without warning. In Du Jinghua's impression, everyone around them owned one.

But she couldn't remember who provided the game console or how it fell into everyone's hands.

But at the same time, Du Jinghua clearly remembered the various requirements for using the game console.

The game console comes with some mini-games, which are few at first, but the more you play, the more you can unlock. People who own game consoles need to play games regularly, continue to explore, and record the content.

There are also connections between games. All games have a common background "Lost Continent".

Du Jinghua remembered that she had recorded the contents of many copies, but she could not remember the reason why she did so.

...You can never be idle.

Just like people have to breathe and fish can swim, people accept the settings imposed on them without any obstacles, and playing games has inexplicably become a necessity in life.

For a while, Du Jinghua took the game console with him wherever he went and played with it whenever he had time.

Most of her limited free time was taken up, and it even affected the progress of completing the thesis.

Then from one day to the next, there will be fewer and fewer people around who insist on playing game consoles.

Du Jinghua put the game console in the utility cabinet at home and only took it out every few days.

The reason why she had an impression of the original Labyrinth Titan was because she had played related games on the game console, but that impression had become very shallow, as if some kind of power had covered her mind with a curtain in a very targeted manner, preventing her from remembering anything about the game console.

Pulling his thoughts away from his memories, Du Jinghua took the time to examine the remains of the attacker.

She pulled the arrow from the attacker's chest and slowly wiped the arrow with a tissue.Du Jinghua lowered his gaze and stared at the remains on the ground, with a cold expression that was inconsistent with the temperament of a college student.

The attacker dropped some items that looked unrealistic at first glance.

[System: Congratulations to the player for obtaining [Backpack Space]×2.Note: This item is bound.】

[System: Congratulations to the player for obtaining [Trait Evolution Card (Specified)] × 1.Note: This item is bound.】

[System: Congratulations to the player for obtaining [N-level skill card]×1.】

The moment Du Jinghua finished picking up the things, the remains of the attacker completely disappeared.

She gathered up her slightly thin windbreaker, took one last look at the dark abandoned community, and turned to leave without looking back.

00:36 am.

The first thing Du Jinghua did when he returned to his rental place was to look for the game console in the utility cabinet, and then he discovered a piece of good news and an unknown piece of news.

Good news, the console is indeed still around.

Unexplained news - after the game console was found, it turned into a beam of light and completely disappeared between Du Jinghua's eyebrows.
